object.attr: analysis: Q-V5's second step, to confirm: a pushed object is already referred to by others. Mellon doesn't fetch, so remote-tracking branches can be old; accepted, with "fetch before merging" in TEAM.md (review Q57, handed to Process). Replaces MELLON-VER-SRS-331.
object.description: When issue tags reach both or neither of two creating commits of one object ID, and remote-tracking branches reach exactly one, Mellon shall renumber the other object.
